lore.common: Hides its partner under the bed every morning just as you're late for school.
lore.uncommon: Ties its laces in a double knot so tight that nobody can get it off again.
lore.rare: Tracked mud from the garden right across the clean kitchen floor and up the stairs.
lore.epic: Stomped through every puddle on the school walk, and the whole class went home soaked to the knees.
lore.legendary: Walked a thousand miles across mountains and moors and came home with only a small hole in one toe.

lore.common: Spins round so wide when you twirl that it knocks the cake off the table.
lore.uncommon: Catches its hem on every door handle on the way out of the party.
lore.rare: Got its zip stuck halfway up so its owner had to walk out sideways.
lore.epic: Twirled so beautifully across the dance floor that every guest stopped to watch.
lore.legendary: Was worn to three weddings, two proms and one very surprised birthday party, and still looks brand new.

names.legendary: Woolly Wilbur of the Winter Peaks

lore.common: Itches your nose all morning, and it's the one place you can't scratch.
lore.uncommon: Leaves only your eyes showing, so nobody recognises you at the bus stop.
lore.rare: Kept a climber's face warm on the top of a freezing mountain.
lore.epic: Kept every child in the school warm on the snowiest day, and nobody's ears went red.
lore.legendary: Climbed the highest mountain in the world on a famous climber's head, and came back with frozen eyebrows.

lore.common: Slips down over your eyes every time you run.
lore.uncommon: Flaps round your neck in the wind like a little flag.
lore.rare: Wiped the sweat off a whole team of builders on the hottest day of the year.
lore.epic: Was waved by every fan in the stadium at once, and the whole crowd turned red.
lore.legendary: Rode across the prairie on a cowboy's neck for twenty years and kept every speck of dust out of his mouth.

lore.common: Pulls your hair every time you take it off after swimming.
lore.uncommon: Squeezes your head so tightly that your ears pop.
lore.rare: Kept a swimmer's hair completely dry for a whole hour, which nobody believed.
lore.epic: Was worn by every swimmer in the race, and the pool looked like a bowl of bobbing sweets.
lore.legendary: Swam the whole channel on a famous swimmer's head without letting in a single drop.

names.legendary: Grand Fuzzbusby of the Palace Guard

lore.common: Tickles the nose of every guard standing next to it, and none of them are allowed to sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Is so tall and furry that its owner has to duck under every doorway.
lore.rare: Stayed perfectly still in a gale while every other hat blew away.
lore.epic: Marched with a hundred other bearskins down the parade, and the street looked like a furry forest.
lore.legendary: Has stood outside the palace gate through every storm for fifty years without ever wobbling.

lore.common: Slides off to one side no matter how carefully you put it on.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it think they are a great painter.
lore.rare: Sat on the head of a painter by the river who painted the whole city in one afternoon.
lore.epic: Was worn by every artist in the square at once, and the tourists bought every painting.
lore.legendary: Has been worn by three generations of painters and has paint splodges in every colour ever made.

names.legendary: Sir Bowlerby of the Morning Train

lore.common: Rolls off your head on the windiest day and down the high street.
lore.uncommon: Goes everywhere with an umbrella, and won't be seen without one.
lore.rare: Was raised so politely at the bus stop that the whole queue raised theirs too.
lore.epic: Bobbed along with a thousand other bowlers on the morning train, and the platform looked like a field of mushrooms.
lore.legendary: Has ridden the same morning train on the same head for forty years and never once been rained on.

lore.common: Flops down over your eyes every time you try to look up.
lore.uncommon: Has a floppy brim all the way round so the rain drips off in every direction.
lore.rare: Survived three muddy festivals and came home smelling of chips.
lore.epic: Was worn by every person in the festival crowd at once, and the field looked like a sea of upside-down buckets.
lore.legendary: Has been to every summer festival for twenty years and has a badge from every single one.

lore.common: Is so heavy that it slides down over your ears every time you nod.
lore.uncommon: Sparkles so brightly in the sun that everyone has to squint at you.
lore.rare: Was hidden in a cake by a cheeky prince and found by the cook.
lore.epic: Glittered so brightly at the parade that the whole crowd needed sunglasses.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at coronations for a thousand years and is still polished every single morning.

names.legendary: Lady Muffington of the Ice Rink

lore.common: Muffles every word you say so you answer the wrong questions all day.
lore.uncommon: Has two fluffy pom-poms that make you look like a bear.
lore.rare: Kept your ears so warm that you didn't hear the school bell.
lore.epic: Was worn by the whole ice-skating club, and nobody heard the coach for an entire lesson.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same skater's ears warm through forty winters of early-morning practice.

lore.common: Tips forward over your eyes every time you look mysterious.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it suddenly want to solve a mystery.
lore.rare: Hid its owner's face so well in the shadows that the cat didn't recognise him.
lore.epic: Was worn by every detective at the mystery party, and nobody could work out who was who.
lore.legendary: Has solved fifty cases on the same detective's head, and was given a little badge of its own.

names.legendary: Old Topper, Hat of All Hats

lore.common: Flies off your head on every windy day and leads you on a chase down the street.
lore.uncommon: Leaves your hair squashed flat when you take it off, so you have to keep it on.
lore.rare: Swapped heads with every hat at the party when nobody was looking.
lore.epic: Blew away in a gale with every other hat in town, and they all landed in the duck pond.
lore.legendary: Has been worn by five generations of the same family and still fits every one of them.

lore.common: Slides down over your eyes just as you're about to catch the ball.
lore.uncommon: Holds back your hair so tightly that your eyebrows look surprised.
lore.rare: Soaked up a whole tennis match of sweat without dripping once.
lore.epic: Was worn by every runner at the school sports day, and the finish line looked like a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at every marathon for twenty years and still stretches just right.

lore.common: Its tassel swings in front of your nose and makes you sneeze.
lore.uncommon: Has a flat square top that slides off whenever you look down.
lore.rare: Was thrown in the air at graduation and landed on the head of the headmistress.
lore.epic: Was tossed in the air by every graduate at once, and the sky rained square hats.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at so many graduations that it knows more than all the professors together.

lore.common: Crinkles so loudly in the shower that you can't hear yourself singing.
lore.uncommon: Looks like a see-through bubble on your head, and everyone laughs.
lore.rare: Kept a whole hairdo dry through a twenty-minute bath.
lore.epic: Was worn by everyone in the hotel on the same morning, and the corridors crinkled.
lore.legendary: Has kept the same grandma's curls dry through every bath for thirty years.

lore.common: Gets damp from your breath and then freezes stiff on the ski lift.
lore.uncommon: Covers everything but your eyes, so you look like a woolly ninja.
lore.rare: Kept a skier's face warm while flying down the steepest slope.
lore.epic: Kept the whole ski school warm on the coldest day of the season.
lore.legendary: Skied down every mountain in the range on the same face and never once got snow up its nose.

lore.common: Blows off into the sea the moment you get to the beach.
lore.uncommon: Has a brim so wide that the whole family can sit in its shade.
lore.rare: Kept a gardener cool through a whole afternoon of digging in the heat.
lore.epic: Shaded every grandma at the beach on the hottest day, and nobody got burnt.
lore.legendary: Has been to the beach every summer for forty years and still smells faintly of suncream.

lore.common: Slips out of your hair and falls into the punch bowl.
lore.uncommon: Sparkles in every photo, so nobody can see your face.
lore.rare: Was found by a pigeon and taken to its nest, where it still sparkles.
lore.epic: Sparkled so much at the ball that the chandelier felt jealous.
lore.legendary: Has been worn at every royal ball for a hundred years and has never lost a single jewel.

names.legendary: Coach Shadewell of the Tennis Club

lore.common: Has no top, so the sun burns your head while your eyes stay shaded.
lore.uncommon: Blocks the glare so well that you can watch the ball against the sun.
lore.rare: Kept a tennis player's eyes shaded through a five-hour match.
lore.epic: Was worn by every player at the tennis tournament, and the court looked like a field of little roofs.
lore.legendary: Has watched every final at the same tennis club for thirty years.

names.legendary: Madame Perruque of the Grand Theatre

lore.common: Slips sideways on your head during the school play.
lore.uncommon: Has curls so bouncy that they wobble when you talk.
lore.rare: Blew off in the wind and landed on a dog, which wore it proudly all the way home.
lore.epic: Was swapped between every actor in the play, and the audience couldn't keep track.
lore.legendary: Has been worn in every play at the grand theatre for a hundred years and still has every curl.

lore.common: Squashes your hair flat and leaves a line round your forehead.
lore.uncommon: Bonks against every door frame because you forget you're wearing it.
lore.rare: Bounced off a low branch on the bike ride and its owner didn't even feel it.
lore.epic: Was worn by every worker on the building site, and the bricks bounced off them all.
lore.legendary: Has saved its owner from a hundred tumbles and still has the same sticker on the back.

names.legendary: Grand Overcoat of the Coat Rack

lore.common: Hides your keys in a pocket you didn't even know it had.
lore.uncommon: Jams its zip at the bottom so you have to wriggle out of it like a snake.
lore.rare: Kept a whole wallet, two sandwiches and a hamster in its pockets without anyone noticing.
lore.epic: Was hung on the same coat hook as every other jacket in the school, and the hook bent to the floor.
lore.legendary: Has been passed down through three brothers and still has the first brother's conker in the pocket.

lore.common: Comes out of the washing machine one size smaller every single time.
lore.uncommon: Has pockets full of fluff, old tissues and a forgotten sweet.
lore.rare: Ripped at the knee on the playground and became even more fashionable.
lore.epic: Shrunk so much in the wash that the whole family had to try them on to find who they fitted.
lore.legendary: Has been worn for twenty years and faded to the perfect blue, with every patch telling a story.

lore.common: Catches in the car door every time you get out.
lore.uncommon: Dries your hands, your face and the dog, all on the same day.
lore.rare: Wrapped round so many times that you couldn't turn your head.
lore.epic: Was knitted so long that it went round the whole school choir at once.
lore.legendary: Was knitted by grandma every winter for fifty years and now reaches all the way to the end of the street.

names.legendary: Professor Robesworth of the Old Hall

lore.common: Swishes its long sleeves into your dinner at every formal meal.
lore.uncommon: Is so long that it sweeps the floor of every corridor it walks down.
lore.rare: Billowed out so dramatically on the stage that the professor nearly floated away.
lore.epic: Led a procession of a thousand gowns across the university lawn, and the ducks waddled out of the way.
lore.legendary: Has been worn by every head of the university for two hundred years and still swishes perfectly.

names.legendary: Sir Bibbington, Hero of the Highchair

lore.common: Catches everything except the food that falls in your lap.
lore.uncommon: Ties at the back of your neck, then comes undone just before pudding.
lore.rare: Survived a whole bowl of spaghetti and still came out mostly white.
lore.epic: Caught a whole birthday cake's worth of crumbs at the toddler party.
lore.legendary: Has been worn by four babies in the same family and still has the same duck on the front.

lore.common: Comes out of the washing machine tangled round every sock in the load.
lore.uncommon: Has tiny hooks at the back that are very fiddly to do up in a hurry.
lore.rare: Hooked itself onto a jumper in the wash and refused to let go.
lore.epic: Flapped on the washing line in a gale, and the neighbours found it in their garden.
lore.legendary: Has survived a thousand washes and still has every hook and every bit of lace.

names.legendary: Sir Steelheart, Shield of the Knight

lore.common: Clanks so loudly when you walk that everyone knows you're coming.
lore.uncommon: Is polished so shiny that the knight can see his breakfast in it.
lore.rare: Bounced an arrow straight back at the archer who fired it.
lore.epic: Clanked down the castle wall with a hundred other knights, and the sound echoed for miles.
lore.legendary: Has protected a dozen knights over five hundred years and now stands proudly in the castle hall.

names.legendary: Sir Linksworth of the Iron Rings

lore.common: Jingles with every step, so knights can never sneak up on anyone.
lore.uncommon: Is made of a thousand tiny metal rings joined together.
lore.rare: Stopped a sword's swipe and only lost one tiny ring.
lore.epic: Rattled across the battlefield with a hundred other knights, and the horses wore earplugs.
lore.legendary: Was linked together ring by ring over a whole year by one patient blacksmith, and has never broken.

lore.common: Clanks against the table every time its knight leans over to reach the salt.
lore.uncommon: Is polished so brightly that the knight checks his hair in it before every joust.
lore.rare: Made a sword slide off its curved front and into a hay bale.
lore.epic: Clattered through the tournament gates with fifty other knights, and the horses wore earplugs.
lore.legendary: Was hit by a hundred lances in one tournament and came out with only a slightly sad dent.

names.legendary: Captain Absorbo of the Changing Mat

lore.common: Comes untaped at exactly the wrong moment, usually in the middle of the supermarket.
lore.uncommon: Crinkles so loudly when the baby crawls that everyone knows where it is.
lore.rare: Held on through a whole car journey to grandma's, and everyone cheered.
lore.epic: Was changed twelve times in one day during the big family visit, and the bin gave up.
lore.legendary: Kept a baby dry all through a long-haul flight, and the whole plane applauded at landing.

lore.common: Rides up every time you climb out of the pool, and you have to tug it straight.
lore.uncommon: Stretches so much that it fits on every swimmer in the family.
lore.rare: Dived into the pool so smoothly that the water barely rippled.
lore.epic: Swam in every race at the gala, and the pool looked like a bowl of colourful fish.
lore.legendary: Swam the length of the bay a hundred times one summer and never faded a shade.

names.legendary: Lord Snoozewell of the Bunk Bed

lore.common: Is buttoned up wrongly every night, so one side always hangs lower.
lore.uncommon: Has little cartoons all over it that seem to dance when you're nearly asleep.
lore.rare: Kept a child warm through a whole night of camping without a single shiver.
lore.epic: Started a pillow fight at the sleepover that went on until sunrise.
lore.legendary: Has been worn to a hundred sleepovers and still knows every secret whispered in the dark.

lore.common: Comes undone at the knot just as you stand up from your beach towel.
lore.uncommon: Can be worn as a skirt, a scarf, a picnic blanket or a sunshade.
lore.rare: Fluttered in the sea breeze so gracefully that the seagulls stopped to watch.
lore.epic: Was sold in every colour at the beach market, and the whole shore turned into a rainbow.
lore.legendary: Has been tied round a thousand beach holidays and still smells faintly of sun cream.

names.legendary: Big Splashworth of the Diving Board

lore.common: Its drawstring always disappears back inside the waistband.
lore.uncommon: Drips water all over the car seat on the way home from the beach.
lore.rare: Did a cannonball off the side of the pool so big that the lifeguard got soaked.
lore.epic: Did a belly flop at the beach party, and the wave knocked every sandcastle down.
lore.legendary: Jumped off the highest diving board at the pool and came up with the biggest splash in history.

names.legendary: Old Comfy, Favourite of All Time

lore.common: Its label scratches the back of your neck all day long.
lore.uncommon: Comes out of the washing basket inside out every single time.
lore.rare: Attracted every drop of ketchup at the barbecue, and never a drop on the plate.
lore.epic: Got mixed up with every other shirt in the laundry pile, and the whole family wore the wrong ones for a week.
lore.legendary: Has been worn so many times that it is now soft as a cloud and has a hole in exactly the right place.

names.legendary: Madame Rideau of the Royal Stage

lore.common: Gets stuck halfway open on opening night, so the audience sees only half the actors.
lore.uncommon: Opens so slowly that the actors have to stand still and wait.
lore.rare: Swept across the stage so fast that it knocked off the villain's hat.
lore.epic: Rose on opening night to a full house, and the whole theatre gasped at once.
lore.legendary: Has opened on ten thousand shows and still takes the final bow with the actors.

names.legendary: Lady Velveteen of the Drawing Room

lore.common: Feels lovely one way and horrible the other, so everyone strokes it in the right direction.
lore.uncommon: Shows every thumbprint you make, so it looks like someone has been writing on it.
lore.rare: Grabbed every cat hair in the house and refused to let any of them go.
lore.epic: Covered every cushion in the grand house, and the guests sank in up to their elbows.
lore.legendary: Has been sat on by princesses, poets and one very sleepy dog, and still feels soft as moss.

lore.common: Has sleeves so long that they sweep through every bowl of soup.
lore.uncommon: Is embroidered with so much gold thread that it glitters under every lamp.
lore.rare: Swished so grandly down the long hall that the candles flickered as it passed.
lore.epic: Was worn by the whole ceremonial procession, and the hall glittered like a treasure chest.
lore.legendary: Was stitched by fifty people over ten years and still has every single gold thread in place.

lore.common: Tangles itself into a giant knot every time the kitten is in the room.
lore.uncommon: Is spun from a sheep's fleece into a soft fluffy ball.
lore.rare: Shrank in the wash from a jumper into a doll's vest.
lore.epic: Rolled out of the knitting basket and wound itself round every chair leg in the house.
lore.legendary: Was spun into a scarf so long that it went round the whole village and back.

names.legendary: Lady Glovington of the Hat Stand

lore.common: Loses one of itself on every bus ride, so there's always one lonely glove left.
lore.uncommon: Never has your fingers in the right holes the first time.
lore.rare: Gripped the bike handlebars on the iciest morning without slipping once.
lore.epic: Made a hundred snowballs in one afternoon, and the snowman was very nervous.
lore.legendary: Has stayed together as a pair for twenty years, which is a world record for gloves.

lore.common: Has only a thumb hole, so you can't pick up anything smaller than a snowball.
lore.uncommon: Is tied together with a string through your coat sleeves so it can never get lost.
lore.rare: Got so caked with snow that it turned into two little snowmen.
lore.epic: Made a snow fort with every child in the street, and the snowball fight lasted till dark.
lore.legendary: Was knitted by granny forty years ago and has kept four children's hands warm since.

names.legendary: Sir Sockington, Last of His Pair

lore.common: Always comes out of the washing machine with only one of itself.
lore.uncommon: Gets a hole in the big toe just when you're about to take your shoes off at a friend's house.
lore.rare: Smelled so bad after football that the dog ran out of the room.
lore.epic: Vanished in the washing machine with every other sock in the house, and turned up a week later inside the duvet cover.
lore.legendary: Is the only sock in history to come out of the washing machine with its partner every single time.

names.legendary: Lady Bowella of the Gift Wrap

lore.common: Comes undone at the worst moment and trails behind like a tail.
lore.uncommon: Gets pulled into a tighter knot every time someone tries to untie it.
lore.rare: Sat on top of a present so beautifully that nobody wanted to open it.
lore.epic: Was tied on every present at the birthday party, and the room looked like a bow shop.
lore.legendary: Has been tied in so many hair-dos, parcels and puppies that it knows every knot there is.

lore.common: Dips itself into your soup every time you lean forward.
lore.uncommon: Is tied too tight in the morning and pulled loose by lunch.
lore.rare: Flapped over its owner's shoulder in the wind and slapped him on the ear.
lore.epic: Was worn round every head at the office party, and nobody could remember which was theirs.
lore.legendary: Has been tied in a perfect knot every morning for forty years by the same patient grandad.

lore.common: Pinches your ankle every time you zip it up.
lore.uncommon: Hops over puddles on tiptoes so its suede doesn't get wet.
lore.rare: Clicked its heels so loudly in the hallway that the dog thought someone was knocking.
lore.epic: Strode down every street in the city during fashion week, and the pavements clicked like a clock.
lore.legendary: Has walked a thousand miles of city pavements and still has its original heels.

lore.common: Pricks your finger every time you pin it on.
lore.uncommon: Is collected by the hundred and pinned to every inch of a school bag.
lore.rare: Glinted so brightly in the sun that the whole class had to squint at assembly.
lore.epic: Started a badge swap at the fair, and every jacket in town came home covered.
lore.legendary: Has been pinned to three generations of the same jacket, and still shines like new.

lore.common: Slips off your heel every time you run for the bus.
lore.uncommon: Makes everyone who wears it walk on tiptoe as if they're on a stage.
lore.rare: Spun round so fast at practice that it squeaked on the wooden floor.
lore.epic: Twirled in perfect time with every dancer in the recital, and the audience stood up to clap.
lore.legendary: Danced the lead in a hundred ballets and never once missed a step.

lore.common: Its belt trails on the floor and gets caught under the door.
lore.uncommon: Is so fluffy and warm that you never want to take it off.
lore.rare: Answered the door to the postman so confidently that he thought it was a business suit.
lore.epic: Was worn round the house all Sunday by the whole family, and nobody got dressed at all.
lore.legendary: Has been worn every morning for twenty years and still smells like warm toast.

names.legendary: Old Buckleworth of the Trouser Rack

lore.common: Is always one notch too tight after a big dinner.
lore.uncommon: Clanks its buckle on the chair every time you sit down.
lore.rare: Held up a pair of trousers two sizes too big all through the school play.
lore.epic: Had to be let out a notch by every grandad at the holiday feast.
lore.legendary: Has held up the same trousers for forty years, through every big dinner and birthday cake.

lore.common: Comes untied at the knot just as you wave to someone on the beach.
lore.uncommon: Leaves funny white tan lines after a day in the sun.
lore.rare: Collected so much sand during a swim that it weighed twice as much coming out.
lore.epic: Played in the beach volleyball match with every team on the sand, and the crowd cheered every dive.
lore.legendary: Has been to a hundred beaches and never once lost a strap.

lore.common: Squeaks on every step down the quiet library corridor.
lore.uncommon: Has little holes punched in patterns all over it, which collect every speck of dust.
lore.rare: Was polished so shiny that its owner could see his reflection in the toe.
lore.epic: Clattered down every office corridor in the building, and everyone knew the boss was coming.
lore.legendary: Has been resoled ten times and walked to the same office every day for thirty years.

names.legendary: Captain Swoosh of the Garden Wall

lore.common: Catches in every door on the way out of the house.
lore.uncommon: Flaps dramatically behind you whenever you run, even indoors.
lore.rare: Made its wearer feel so heroic that he rescued a cat from a very low branch.
lore.epic: Was worn by every child at the dress-up party, and the garden turned into a superhero academy.
lore.legendary: Swooped off the garden wall so bravely that the whole street called its wearer a hero for a week.

lore.common: Gets its sleeve caught on every door handle, then unravels a little bit more each time.
lore.uncommon: Has leather patches on its elbows that make everyone look like a professor.
lore.rare: Hid a whole pack of mints, a pencil and three tissues in its pockets.
lore.epic: Was worn by every grandparent at the family reunion, and the room looked like a knitting catalogue.
lore.legendary: Was knitted by granny fifty years ago and still has the same wooden buttons.

names.legendary: Lord Chelsington of the High Street

lore.common: Needs its little tab pulled so hard that you fall over backwards putting it on.
lore.uncommon: Has stretchy sides so you can slip it on without any laces.
lore.rare: Strutted through a rainstorm and came out without a single drop inside.
lore.epic: Strutted down the high street with every other boot in town, and the shops opened early.
lore.legendary: Has walked the same city streets for thirty years and still looks freshly polished.

names.legendary: Golden Studs, Scorer of the Final

lore.common: Leaves clumps of mud on every floor between the pitch and the car.
lore.uncommon: Clacks so loudly on the changing room floor that the whole team marches.
lore.rare: Gripped the muddiest pitch so well that its owner never slipped once.
lore.epic: Charged down the pitch with every player in the cup final, and the turf flew everywhere.
lore.legendary: Scored the winning goal in the cup final from the halfway line.

names.legendary: Lady Crimpwell of the Rock Face

lore.common: Squeezes your toes so tightly that you hobble back to the car.
lore.uncommon: Is always covered in chalk dust that gets all over the car seats.
lore.rare: Gripped a tiny ledge on the cliff that nobody else could even see.
lore.epic: Scrambled up every route on the bouldering wall in one afternoon.
lore.legendary: Climbed the steepest cliff in the country without slipping once.

lore.common: Drags its hem through every puddle, so it comes home heavier than it left.
lore.uncommon: Swirls round its wearer in the wind like a little storm.
lore.rare: Kept its wearer dry through a whole night of rain in the forest.
lore.epic: Was worn by every storyteller at the midnight festival, and the forest seemed to whisper.
lore.legendary: Has walked every mountain road in the north and kept its wearer warm through a hundred winters.

names.legendary: Old Klompen of the Tulip Fields

lore.common: Clomps so loudly on the stairs that the whole house wakes up.
lore.uncommon: Is carved out of a single piece of wood and doesn't bend at all.
lore.rare: Kept a gardener's feet dry in the muddiest flowerbed for a whole spring.
lore.epic: Danced a clog dance with every clog in the village square, and the cobbles rang like bells.
lore.legendary: Has walked the same tulip fields for a hundred years and never needed a new sole.
